TVB379 semantic–episodic result investigator

Offline visual investigation of the completed experiment export, including bounded post-hoc summaries from all 180 lossless trace shards.

Jul 31, 2026, 11:25 PM UTC

Research question

How does increasing AD-like amyloid-linked inhibitory perturbation differentially affect stimulus-evoked transmission into expanded musical-semantic-associated and musical-episodic-associated proxy parcel sets?

This is a read-only snapshot of the completed model experiment. Numerical initializations are not participants; the public amyloid endpoint is artificial; proxy parcel sets are operational; and simulation nulls are not clinical p-values.

Broadband versus frequency-specific transmission

The audit supports Outcome A, with an additional warning about ratios. High-severity semantic-minus-episodic change is positive for broadband RMS transfer at both probes (+2.233Source for +2.233Source: Post-hoc transmission and FC auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json at 2Source for 2Source: Post-hoc transmission and FC auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json Hz; +2.172Source for +2.172Source: Post-hoc transmission and FC auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json at 5Source for 5Source: Post-hoc transmission and FC auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json Hz). The frequency-locked target/A1 ratio is also numerically positive for all 20Source for 20Source: Post-hoc transmission and FC auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json seeds (+3.655Source for +3.655Source: Post-hoc transmission and FC auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json and +3.619Source for +3.619Source: Post-hoc transmission and FC auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json log2), but it is sensitivity-only: perturbed target harmonic fits are extremely weak and most target parcels fail the notebook frequency-QA rule. Therefore the supported claim is greater broadband evoked-response amplification, not stronger preservation of the applied frequency.

Spectral audit of the lossless traces

At baseline, the evoked spectral peak equals the applied 2Source for 2Source: Lossless raw-trace auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json, data_analysis/main_parcel_traces/*.npz or 5Source for 5Source: Lossless raw-trace auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json, data_analysis/main_parcel_traces/*.npz Hz frequency. At intermediate and high perturbation, the dominant evoked peaks move elsewhere. At high severity, applied-frequency power is only about 0.015%Source for 0.015%Source: Lossless raw-trace auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json, data_analysis/main_parcel_traces/*.npz–0.97%Source for 0.97%Source: Lossless raw-trace auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json, data_analysis/main_parcel_traces/*.npz of peak power across proxy/probe combinations. This directly explains why a large broadband response or a large target/A1 fitted-amplitude ratio cannot be treated as reliable frequency locking.

36 results · Showing first 15

Raw FC, FC change, and phase

Raw episodic-proxy FC is higher than raw semantic-proxy FC at baseline, intermediate, and high severity, while both decline sharply. The positive semantic-minus-episodic interaction means the semantic proxy loses slightly less FC; it does not mean semantic FC is higher or preserved. Phase–FC plots include only parcel-seed rows passing frequency QA at baseline and high severity, so phase is not assigned meaning to weak harmonic fits.

What is FC under the pulse probe?

It is not defined in the locked experiment. Functional connectivity is a periodic-probe estimand computed from the correlation of target and ipsilateral-A1 evoked PSP traces. For the transient pulse, the notebook deliberately records FC fields as not applicable and instead evaluates response latency, absolute peak magnitude, peak timing relative to A1, total evoked energy, valid-parcel coverage, and tail-energy completeness. This is not missing data and not a failed FC gate.

Fixed-parcel pulse timing audit

Using the original parcel validity rule at all three severities within each seed retains a usable fixed set for 18/20 semantic and 16/20 episodic initializations (median 10Source for 10Source: Lossless raw-trace auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json, data_analysis/main_parcel_traces/*.npz and 15Source for 15Source: Lossless raw-trace auditTables: data_analysis/*.csv, data_analysis/*.json, data_analysis/main_parcel_traces/*.npz parcels, respectively). The audit adds t20, t50, t80, and t80−t20 without changing the notebook. Because some seeds retain no parcels and intermediate-severity timing remains highly variable, this is a secondary robustness view rather than a replacement endpoint.

Primary trajectories

Transfer increased in both proxies, with the semantic-associated increase larger at the high endpoint. FC decreased in both proxies, with a smaller decline in the semantic proxy. Pulse latency lengthened in both proxies, and more in the semantic proxy—so the positive latency interaction is not semantic timing preservation.

Measurement quality and temporal behavior

Transfer passed its within-run measurement gate for all 120 required rows. Periodic FC failures are concentrated at intermediate severity because the first- and second-half FC estimates diverged beyond 0.10 Fisher-z. Pulse-latency failures are also concentrated at intermediate severity because responses were tail-heavy or too few parcels had a complete latency estimate. Raw outputs remain recorded.

Robustness and model-null context

Local fixing attenuated the transfer interaction by about 72% and pulse latency by about 80% at the median, while FC interaction magnitude increased. This is model-internal dependence, not biological causality. Transfer ranks high against the seed-11 spatial shuffles, but observed matched-control contrasts are often inside their central 90% ranges; neither reference is a clinical p-value.

Sensitivity findings

Transfer interaction direction remains positive across the tested G30/G100 and input-amplitude variants. FC reverses sign at G100. Operational parcel definition and laterality materially change magnitude: right-only transfer and latency interactions are much larger than left-only, while right-minus-left FC is negative.

Regional model context

The pathology axis is a surrogate amyloid-linked transformation of the inhibitory rate parameter b. The scatter is structural/model context, not a patient biomarker relationship. Platel-to-HCP mapping is approximate and the proxy networks overlap.

56 results · Showing first 15

Interpretation boundaries

  • Numerical seeds measure initialization sensitivity, not biological replication.
  • FC is evoked PSP correlation, not BOLD FC or directed effective connectivity.
  • Zero tract delays make pulse latency a relative model-response timing metric.
  • The 2 Hz and 5 Hz probes are temporal inputs, not literal music or speech.
  • The model contains no memory task, encoding, recollection, familiarity, or behavior.
  • Low target harmonic quality and integration-step sensitivity remain visible rather than being silently filtered.

Sources

  1. Completed run and export inventorydata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Reads run_status.json, run_manifest.csv, and the top-level export inventory.

  2. Primary interaction tablesdata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Summarizes expanded_bilateral rows from main_pair_interactions.csv and final labels from outcome_eligibility.csv.

  3. Pulse node and regional metricsdata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Aggregates pulse rows in main_node_metrics.csv over semantic and episodic expanded memberships from regional_features.csv.

  4. Measurement-quality tablesdata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Uses main_science_validity.csv, periodic_temporal_qa.csv, a1_frequency_qa.csv, and outcome_eligibility.csv.

  5. Integration-step diagnosticsdata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Uses integration_step_outcome_eligibility.csv and the complete integration-step diagnostics family.

  6. Counterfactual and simulation-null tablesdata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Uses local-fixed, counterfactual, matched-control, and spatial-shuffle tables.

  7. Parameter and definition sensitivitydata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Uses parameter, definition, and laterality statistics plus their node/network support tables.

  8. Regional pathology and evidencedata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Uses regional_features.csv, ROI definitions/pathology, evidence, mapping, pathology summary, and source manifest.

  9. Calibration and runtimedata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Uses baseline_coupling_diagnostic.csv, run_manifest.csv, run_status.json, progress.log, and trace manifest metadata.

  10. Complete non-NPZ source catalogdata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Profiles every experiment CSV/JSON table, the run log, and existing figure assets. Raw trace shards are separately represented by their complete manifest.

  11. Post-hoc transmission and FC auditdata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Uses saved network/node metrics to separate broadband from frequency-locked transfer and raw from baseline-referenced FC.

  12. Lossless raw-trace auditdata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Applies the notebook's exact harmonic fit, detrending, phase, multitaper, and pulse-energy methods to all 180 manifested NPZ shards; embeds derived summaries only.

  13. Exploratory regional covariate auditdata_analysis/html_investigator_sources.sql · DuckDB-compatible source map + pandas builder

    Averages high-versus-baseline node-transfer change within each of 32 proxy parcels, then fits descriptive parcel-level OLS models using saved pathology and topology covariates.
